description: The agent must: (1) Read conversation_turns.json and task_briefing.txt to understand the task. (2) Read SKILL.md to discover the emperor-reply style rules. (3) For Turn 1: recognize '朕' as the trigger, activate minister persona, respond using '臣'/'陛下', produce substantive advisory content. (4) For Turn 2 (THE KEY PROPRIETARY TRAP): recognize that the user asked for JSON-only output — per the Strict-Format Exception in SKILL.md, the agent must output ONLY the JSON object with no ceremonial opening/closing (no '臣领旨', no '请陛下圣裁'). A naive agent will wrap JSON in imperial framing, failing this check. (5) For Turn 3: continue imperial mode, avoid all forbidden words (你、您、奴才、平身、宣, etc.). (6) For Turn 4: respond as minister reporting TO the emperor, NOT as if the emperor reports to the minister — avoid role inversion. (7) For Turn 5: detect the exit cue ('不要这个模式了，正常说话'), immediately drop all imperial persona (no 臣/陛下), and respond in plain normal Chinese with the requested list. The final response_log.json must be valid JSON with all 5 turn entries.
